expected.labelNote: Base64 is present, but the loaded commons-codec 1.11 jar lacks encodeBase64String(byte[], boolean), so linkage fails at the call. That is the same dependency-classpath family as ClassNotFoundException and NoClassDefFoundError, so primary is DEPENDENCY_FAILURE. UNKNOWN is acceptable because the taxonomy's dependency examples name those two classes and HTTP 5xx, not NoSuchMethodError, and a reviewer can treat a binary incompatibility as an application packaging defect.
